## Stop alerting on your own stuff, and the toasters got redrawn

**You can ignore a device now.** Your own AirTag in your own pocket and your own doorbell camera are true positives every single time, and a detector that shouts about them constantly is one you stop reading. Tap **IGNORE** and that exact device stops raising the full-screen alert.

It only suppresses the alert. Ignored devices are still scanned, still counted, and still written to the log — so you can always find one again and un-ignore it, and your counters stay honest. The button is a toggle: it reads **MUTED** once a device is on the list, and tapping it again takes it back off. It's on the ALERT screen and on both long-press panels, anywhere you already had HUNT or MORE INFO. The list survives reboots.

**The flying toasters have been rebuilt from the source animation.** Chrome bodies with two slots, and rounded wings mounted on the flanks like a bird's rather than trailing off the back, beating in sync. Toast is now a proper isometric slab with real crust thickness instead of an upright rounded square — and one slice in eight comes out **burnt**, trailing smoke.

**There's a lot more going on out there.** Drifting stars that twinkle, the occasional shooting star, and a rarer comet with a long tail that curves along the path it actually flew.

**Two After Dark cameos**, both rare enough to be a surprise:
- **Boris**, Berkeley Systems' cat, drifting through batting at a slice of toast that stays just out of reach
- **Mowin' Man**, working the bottom edge behind a patch of grass that grows in ahead of him and is cut to stubble behind

**And a new outfit.** Catch the rare gold toaster — tap it as it flies past — and Squachy unlocks **CHROME WING**.

**Squachy stopped disappearing.** He's got a dark outline now, so he holds his shape against the fire and the tunnel instead of sinking into them.

### The actually-useful part
- **Added**: per-device IGNORE, stored on the device and persistent across reboots
- **Added**: IGNORE on the ALERT screen and both long-press confirm panels
- **Added**: burnt toast, stars, shooting stars and comets on the TOASTERS background
- **Added**: Boris and Mowin' Man as rare cameos
- **Added**: CHROME WING outfit, unlocked by catching the gold toaster
- **Changed**: toasters and toast redrawn to match the original animation
- **Changed**: Squachy gained a silhouette outline so he reads on every background
- **Fixed**: outfit unlocking assumed only one outfit could ever be earned by an event
